listings.title: Add Your First Listing Here
listings.description:
## Replace This Listing

Log into the admin panel at **/admin** and click **Property Listings** to add Grace's real properties.

Each listing gets its own shareable landing page — perfect for social media, texting to clients, or running ads.

### What to include

- Great hero photo
- Price and key stats
- A compelling description
- Key features list
- Zillow or MLS link
